column1: # budgets.tsv -- M119a (#2485): the budget table. One row per corpus id
# (join corpus.tsv on `id`). A budget is a CONTRACT: the number the bench
# fails past, derived from a MEASURED baseline by the named margin --
# `budget = baseline x margin`, checked by tools/gate/bench-check.py.
# A row with no baseline, no margin, or no citation does not ship.
# Columns:
#   id        corpus row id (must exist in corpus.tsv)
#   cmp       `<=` (upper bound: latency, wall, buffered bytes) or
#             `>=` (lower bound: throughput)
#   budget    the contract number in the row's unit
#   baseline  the MEASURED value the budget is pinned from. Where the
#             instrument's resolution bounds the observation (e.g. a value
#             observed below one tick), the baseline is the resolution
#             floor, stated on the issue with the raw observation.

# margin the named headroom: `x`, `+|-

%`, or `+|-` (in unit)
#   ref       where the baseline run is recorded: `#<issue>`, `issue:<n>`,
#             or `gate:<id>` (+ optional `; <note>`)
# Baselines measured 2026-10-17 on the development host (Apple silicon,
# macOS 27.2, this branch's tree) and recorded on issue #2485. Two rows
# sit at their instrument's resolution floor: `sysinfo` uptime printed
# ticks=0 (the whole boot fits in the first 1 Hz tick; the runner's own
# marker wait observed ~1.0 s wall to 'kernel terminal state'), and the
# GOSH `time` builtin printed real=0.00s for both commands (centisecond
# resolution) -- both baselines are the floor, stated there.
# Margins re-pinned on #2486 (same host, same day): the first live-bench
# runs showed intra-host spread wider than the margins named from single
# samples -- hf-read 2799..8442 KiB/s across 8 same-shape boots (-67%),
# smp-scale-c1 72.0M..157.4M ticks (2.33x), smp-scale-c2 26.3M..82.8M
# (3.15x). The baselines stay (still the best-case observations); the
# margins now cover the observed spread: hf-read -75% (2799 min, budget
# 2110), c1/c2 x4. smp-scale-c4's observed max (51.7M, 1.55x) already
# fits its x2, unchanged.
